roadmap.title: D.C. campaign and liberation
roadmap.description: Use a fresh, unboosted agent. Finish the D.C. story, both settlements, both settlement projects and all nine liberation bounties before starting an expansion. Visit the named-enemy farm between missions to build a card suit.

roadmap.title: Hard missions and agent progression
roadmap.description: Replay the original 15 missions on Hard or higher. Reach level 40 naturally, finish your specialization tree and craft an exotic.

roadmap.title: Multiplayer and raids
roadmap.description: Complete the Dark Zone and Conflict tasks, then both raids with eight agents. Check the current Dark Zone rules before attempting rogue kills or a hijack.

roadmap.title: Free story episodes
roadmap.description: Finish the first Black Tusk invasion through Tidal Basin, then play the Zoo, Camp White Oak, Pentagon, DARPA and Coney Island missions in story mode.

roadmap.title: Warlords of New York
roadmap.description: Hunt the four lieutenants and finish Liberty Island. Replay a Lower Manhattan mission with a directive active.

roadmap.title: Battle for Brooklyn
roadmap.description: Finish the Brooklyn story and both district liberation bounties. Use Smart Cover and complete the Brooklyn backup tasks. Replay Army Terminal solo if its achievement stays locked.

roadmap.title: Echoes of Central Park
roadmap.description: Finish the Upper West Side main and side missions, explore its control points and use Howl. Retry the two mission challenges as needed, then complete one companion’s upgrades.

achievements.description: Rescue Eleanor Sawyer from the Hyenas in the Grand Washington Hotel.
achievements.summary: Rescue Eleanor Sawyer during the Grand Washington Hotel mission.

guide.context: Keep this agent unboosted until the D.C. campaign is complete. A character boost can block campaign achievements and require a fresh agent.

steps.text: Finish the original @loc{Grand Washington Hotel} story mission.

steps.text: Finish the original @loc{Bank Headquarters} story mission.

achievements.description: Fully upgrade all settlements.
achievements.summary: Bring both the Theater and Campus settlements to upgrade level 4.

guide.context: Complete this on an unboosted agent before starting an expansion. A boost can skip D.C. progression and require a new agent.

steps.text: Complete the missions attached to @loc{Theater} and @loc{Campus} until both settlements show level 4.

achievements.description: Destroy every piece of a tank's armor, then eliminate the tank.
achievements.summary: Remove every armor plate from one tank enemy before killing that tank.

steps.text: Isolate a tank in @loc{American History Museum}. Shoot away the helmet, chest plate, both arm plates and both leg plates before dealing the killing blow.

achievements.description: Discover 20 control points in DC.
achievements.summary: Reveal 20 control points on the Washington, D.C. map.

steps.text: Explore D.C. until 20 red-flag control points have appeared on your map.

achievements.description: Take over a control point in a group without anyone being downed.
achievements.summary: Capture a control point alongside other agents with no group member being downed.

guide.context: If someone is downed, make another attempt at a control point.

steps.text: Form a group with at least one other agent, then capture a control point while keeping every group member on their feet.

achievements.description: Respond to a call for help and revive the agent.
achievements.summary: Answer a backup call and revive the agent who requested help.

steps.text: Accept a @mechanic{Call for Backup} from the map’s SHD tab. Once the requesting agent is downed, revive them.

achievements.description: Put out a call for backup.
achievements.summary: Send a call for backup.

steps.text: Open the map and select @mechanic{Call for Backup}.

achievements.description: Collect any suit of cards in the open world.
achievements.summary: Collect all 13 Snitch Cards belonging to one suit.

guide.context: Any complete suit counts; this checklist follows Spades. Named enemies can appear at the holiday market south of the White House, with a 30-minute wait between spawns after a kill. Check the name before fighting. If the card is already collected, fast travel back and return to change the spawn. Track the suit in Progression → D.C. → Database.

achievements.description: Perform a slide across the hood of a car.
achievements.summary: Slide over the hood of a car.

steps.text: Sprint toward a car hood and use the vault action to slide across.

achievements.description: Shock enemy medics by shooting their defibrillator.
achievements.summary: Shock an enemy medic by destroying their defibrillator pack.

steps.text: Look for an enemy with a plus icon above their health bar. Shoot the defibrillator on their back until the pack breaks.

achievements.description: Get 10 patches from commendations.
achievements.summary: Earn and claim 10 commendation patches.

guide.context: For a commendation with several tiers, finish every tier to earn its patch.

steps.text: Open Progression → Commendations and claim patches from 10 completed commendations.

achievements.description: Help friendlies in resource gathering.
achievements.summary: Give resources to friendly civilians while they are gathering supplies.

steps.text: Follow a friendly gathering patrol from @loc{Theater} to its supply site. When a civilian offers the donation prompt, give them resources.

achievements.description: Access a Safe House in a Dark Zone.
achievements.summary: Enter a safe house inside a Dark Zone.

steps.text: Enter the safe house marked inside Dark Zone East, South or West.

achievements.description: Extract an item from each dark zone.
achievements.summary: Successfully extract at least one item from each of the three Dark Zones.

guide.context: Toxic zones disable rogue actions but require a Stabilization Agent for extraction. Use the map to check the current zone rules.

steps.text: In Dark Zone East, collect contaminated loot from a landmark, call the extraction helicopter and attach your bag to its rope. Stay until the helicopter departs.
Complete an extraction in Dark Zone South and another in Dark Zone West.

achievements.description: Eliminate a rogue agent in each Dark Zone.
achievements.summary: Kill a rogue agent in Dark Zone East, South and West.

guide.context: Rogue protocols are disabled in Toxic zones. Return after the rotation changes if a needed zone is Toxic.

steps.text: Enter a PvP Dark Zone with a partner in your group. Once together inside, have the partner leave the group and activate rogue status, then defeat them.
Earn a rogue-agent kill in each of the other two zones when their rules permit PvP.

achievements.description: Win a match of skirmish or domination.
achievements.summary: Win one Skirmish or Domination match in Conflict.

steps.text: Queue for @mechanic{Skirmish} or @mechanic{Domination} from the map’s Conflict tab and finish on the winning team.

achievements.description: With your clan, face off against another clan in conflict.
achievements.summary: Start a Conflict match as a clan member against an opposing clan member.

guide.context: A win is unnecessary. Join from the start of the match rather than entering a match already in progress.

steps.text: Join or create a clan, then queue for a fresh Conflict match. Play against an opponent with a clan tag.

achievements.description: Complete a bounty from each safe house.
achievements.summary: Complete the nine Washington, D.C. district liberation bounties.

guide.context: Use each district safe house computer to open its liberation project. Complete that project to unlock its bounty. Finish these on an unboosted agent before entering an expansion.

collectibles.name: Meatwagon
collectibles.method: Complete the district liberation project, then activate and finish the @enemy{Meatwagon} bounty.

collectibles.name: 12th Street Spicelords
collectibles.method: Complete the district liberation project, then activate and finish the @enemy{12th Street Spicelords} bounty.

collectibles.name: Wolf Pack
collectibles.method: Complete the district liberation project, then activate and finish the @enemy{Wolf Pack} bounty.

collectibles.name: Jefferson’s Legacy
collectibles.method: Complete the district liberation project, then activate and finish the @enemy{Jefferson’s Legacy} bounty.

collectibles.name: Lafayette’s Regulars

collectibles.name: Kindled Front
collectibles.method: Complete the district liberation project, then activate and finish the @enemy{Kindled Front} bounty.

collectibles.name: Peace Movement
collectibles.method: Complete the district liberation project, then activate and finish the @enemy{Peace Movement} bounty.

collectibles.name: Bully Buzzards
collectibles.method: Complete the district liberation project, then activate and finish the @enemy{Bully Buzzards} bounty.

collectibles.name: Embers Movement
collectibles.method: Complete the district liberation project, then activate and finish the @enemy{Embers Movement} bounty.

achievements.description: Kill one enemy with each of the signature weapons (crossbow, sniper rifle & grenade launcher).
achievements.summary: Use the three original signature weapons to score one kill apiece.

steps.text: Select Survivalist at the White House specialization table and kill an enemy with its crossbow.
Switch to Sharpshooter and get a TAC-50 kill, then switch to Demolitionist and get a grenade-launcher kill.

achievements.description: Shoot 10 enemies in the leg with a crossbow.
achievements.summary: Land crossbow hits on the legs of 10 enemies.

guide.context: If the unlock does not register after 10 hits, keep landing clear leg shots on additional enemies.

steps.text: Equip Survivalist and shoot enemy thighs with the crossbow until 10 enemies have been hit.

achievements.description: Reach Level 30.
achievements.summary: Raise an agent to level 30.

guide.context: A level boost can skip this unlock. Level this agent without boosting.

steps.text: Earn XP from missions and open-world activities until your agent reaches level 30.

achievements.description: Create or join a clan.
achievements.summary: Create a clan or become a member of a clan.

steps.text: Recruit @npc{Grace Larson} through the Theater’s progression, then use clan services at the White House to create or join a clan.

achievements.description: Photo mode: take a photo of a group of 4 agents.
achievements.summary: Take a photo in Photo Mode showing a group of four agents.

steps.text: Gather a group of four agents in one place. Open Photo Mode from the pause menu, frame all four agents and take a photo.

achievements.description: Collect 20 blueprints.
achievements.summary: Obtain 20 crafting blueprints.

steps.text: Collect blueprint rewards from side missions and settlement projects. Buy additional blueprints from vendors until you own 20.

achievements.description: Craft an exotic weapon or item.
achievements.summary: Craft an exotic weapon or equipment item.

guide.context: Look for map markers showing a key and the Hyena faction symbol to locate the faction caches in the listed districts.

steps.text: Search the white wall-mounted key boxes in underground sewers for Hyena keys.
Open the Hyena cache in @loc{Grand Washington Hotel}, Downtown East, until you obtain that district’s Chatterbox component.
In Federal Triangle, open the Hyena cache in the building south of the Theater for the second Chatterbox component.
In Judiciary Square, open the Hyena cache near the Dark Zone boundary for the third Chatterbox component.
With the three components in your inventory, play Bank Headquarters. After defeating Rebound, enter the next office and open the concealed panel in the cabinet on the left for the RFID keycard.
Inside the bank vault, use the keycard to open the room on the left. Spend a Hyena key on its faction cache to obtain the Chatterbox blueprint.
Use the blueprint, the three components and the required materials to craft @item{Chatterbox} at the White House crafting station.

achievements.description: Equip your first specialization.
achievements.summary: Equip a specialization.

steps.text: At level 30, choose a specialization at the table beside the White House Quartermaster.

achievements.description: Invest in each type of upgrade available for a specialization.
achievements.summary: Fully invest 165 points in one specialization’s upgrade tree.

steps.text: Keep one specialization active while earning specialization points from missions, bounties and level-ups.
Spend 165 points across that specialization’s upgrade tree.

achievements.description: Complete a project for both the Theater and Campus settlements.
achievements.summary: Finish a project for each settlement, Theater and Campus, and claim both rewards.

guide.context: Complete this on an unboosted agent before starting an expansion. A boost can skip D.C. progression and require a new agent.

steps.text: Finish a Theater project and collect its reward at the Theater project desk. Do the same for a Campus project.

achievements.description: Equip and use each skill.
achievements.summary: Equip and activate each of the eight original skill types.

collectibles.name: Pulse
collectibles.method: Equip a variant of @mechanic{Pulse} and activate the skill.

collectibles.name: Turret
collectibles.method: Equip a variant of @mechanic{Turret} and activate the skill.

collectibles.name: Hive
collectibles.method: Equip a variant of @mechanic{Hive} and activate the skill.

collectibles.name: Chem Launcher
collectibles.method: Equip a variant of @mechanic{Chem Launcher} and activate the skill.

collectibles.name: Firefly
collectibles.method: Equip a variant of @mechanic{Firefly} and activate the skill.

collectibles.name: Seeker Mine
collectibles.method: Equip a variant of @mechanic{Seeker Mine} and activate the skill.

collectibles.name: Drone
collectibles.method: Equip a variant of @mechanic{Drone} and activate the skill.

collectibles.name: Shield
collectibles.method: Equip a variant of @mechanic{Shield} and activate the skill.

achievements.description: Equip high-end gear (or above) in each slot.
achievements.summary: Equip High-End or higher-quality items in all nine weapon and armor slots.

steps.text: Fill both main weapon slots, your sidearm slot and all six armor slots with High-End yellow items or better.

achievements.description: Hijack an extraction in any occupied dark zone.
achievements.summary: Cut another group’s extraction rope in an occupied Dark Zone.

guide.context: Toxic zones disable rogue actions and cannot be used for a hijack. Check the zone’s Invaded status before each attempt.

steps.text: Enter the PvP Dark Zone currently marked Invaded on the map.
Wait for another group to attach contaminated loot to an extraction rope, then hold the hijack prompt until the rope is cut.

achievements.description: Complete the full Operation Dark Hours raid in a group of eight players.
achievements.summary: Complete Operation Dark Hours with eight agents in the raid group.

steps.text: At level 40, queue for @mechanic{Operation Dark Hours} on Discovery difficulty through the raid menu.
Finish the raid with a full group of eight agents. Wait for replacements before the final encounter if anyone leaves.

achievements.description: Put an end to Emeline Shaw at the Manning National Zoo.
achievements.summary: Defeat Emeline Shaw in the Manning National Zoo mission.

guide.context: Reach level 40 and finish the first Black Tusk invasion through Tidal Basin to open the free episode missions.

steps.text: Complete @loc{Manning National Zoo}.

achievements.description: Take part in the operation at Camp White Oak.
achievements.summary: Complete the Camp White Oak story mission.

guide.context: Reach level 40 and finish the first Black Tusk invasion through Tidal Basin to open the free episode missions.

steps.text: Select the original story mission in mission options rather than a seasonal manhunt variant.
Complete @loc{Camp White Oak}.

achievements.description: Discover the Black Tusk's purpose at the Pentagon and thwart it.
achievements.summary: Stop Black Tusk’s operation in the Pentagon mission.

guide.context: Reach level 40 and finish the first Black Tusk invasion through Tidal Basin to open the free episode missions.

steps.text: Complete Pentagon Breach first.
Complete @loc{The Pentagon}.

achievements.description: Secure the perfusion bioreactor from the DARPA labs below the Pentagon.
achievements.summary: Recover the perfusion bioreactor in the DARPA Research Labs mission.

guide.context: Reach level 40 and finish the first Black Tusk invasion through Tidal Basin to open the free episode missions.

steps.text: Complete the Pentagon mission first.
Complete @loc{DARPA Research Labs}.

achievements.description: Successfully extract Tchernenko after confronting and defeating Elijah Sumner.
achievements.summary: Defeat Elijah Sumner and extract Tchernenko in Coney Island Ballpark.

guide.context: Reach level 40 and finish the first Black Tusk invasion through Tidal Basin to open the free episode missions.

steps.text: Complete @loc{Coney Island Ballpark}.

achievements.description: Prevent Dolores Jones from capturing or killing the rogue Division agent Aaron Keener.
achievements.summary: Stop Dolores Jones in the Coney Island Amusement Park mission.

guide.context: Reach level 40 and finish the first Black Tusk invasion through Tidal Basin to open the free episode missions.

steps.text: Complete @loc{Coney Island Amusement Park}.

achievements.description: Survive all of Theo Parnell's traps and defeat him.
achievements.summary: Defeat Theo Parnell at the end of The Tombs mission.

steps.text: Follow the target’s investigation in Lower Manhattan and finish @loc{The Tombs}.

achievements.description: Shut down the Cleaners' drill and eliminate Javier Kajika.
achievements.summary: Destroy the Cleaners’ drill and defeat Javier Kajika in Pathway Park.

steps.text: Follow the target’s investigation in Lower Manhattan and finish @loc{Pathway Park}.

achievements.description: Defeat James Dragov at the NYC Stock Exchange.
achievements.summary: Defeat James Dragov in the Wall Street mission.

steps.text: Follow the target’s investigation in Lower Manhattan and finish @loc{Wall Street}.

achievements.description: Shutdown the Cleaners' oil refinery and defeat Vivian Conley.
achievements.summary: Stop the refinery and defeat Vivian Conley in Stranded Tanker.

steps.text: Follow the target’s investigation in Lower Manhattan and finish @loc{Stranded Tanker}.

achievements.description: Prevent the missile launch and defeat Aaron Keener.
achievements.summary: Stop Aaron Keener’s missile launch and defeat him on Liberty Island.

steps.text: Defeat Theo Parnell, Javier Kajika, James Dragov and Vivian Conley.
Complete @loc{Liberty Island}, stopping the missile launch and defeating Aaron Keener.

achievements.description: Complete a Main Mission in New York with at least one directive active.
achievements.summary: Complete a main mission in Lower Manhattan while a directive is enabled.

steps.text: After finishing Warlords of New York, open the map’s difficulty options and enable at least one @mechanic{Directive}.
Replay @loc{Pathway Park} and finish the mission with the directive active.

achievements.description: Complete the manhunt and eliminate Aaron Keener.
achievements.summary: Finish the Aaron Keener manhunt by completing Liberty Island.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Liberty Island} after eliminating Aaron Keener’s four lieutenants.

achievements.description: Complete a Seasonal Manhunt mission on Challenge difficulty or above.
achievements.summary: Finish a seasonal manhunt mission at Challenging difficulty or above.

steps.text: At level 40, open the map’s Manhunt tab and select a Legacy Manhunt.
Accept a target, set the final mission to @mechanic{Challenging} or higher and finish the mission.

achievements.description: Shut two car doors while in cover.
achievements.summary: Close two car doors while moving in cover.

steps.text: Find a car with two open doors on one side. Take cover against that side and move past both doors so your agent pushes them shut.

achievements.description: Reach Level 40 with an agent.
achievements.summary: Raise an agent to level 40.

guide.context: An expansion’s level-40 boost can skip this unlock and require a fresh agent. Reach level 40 through earned XP before accepting a boost.

steps.text: Earn XP from missions and open-world activities until your agent reaches level 40.

achievements.description: Complete the full Operation Iron Horse raid in a group of eight players.
achievements.summary: Complete Operation Iron Horse with eight agents in the raid group.

steps.text: At level 40, queue for @mechanic{Operation Iron Horse} on Discovery difficulty through the raid menu.
Finish the raid with a full group of eight agents. Wait for replacements before the final encounter if anyone leaves.

achievements.description: Unlock and use the Smart Cover skill.
achievements.summary: Unlock and deploy the Smart Cover skill.

steps.text: Complete @loc{H5 Refinery} and the following defense of @loc{The Bridge}. Equip @mechanic{Smart Cover} and deploy the skill on cover.

achievements.description: Discover 4 Control Points in Brooklyn.
achievements.summary: Reveal all four Brooklyn control points.

steps.text: Explore @loc{DUMBO} and @loc{Brooklyn Heights} until both control points in each district appear on your map.

achievements.description: Complete a bounty from each Safe House in Brooklyn.
achievements.summary: Finish the liberation bounty for each of Brooklyn’s two safe houses.

steps.text: Use the computer in @loc{The Retreat} in DUMBO and complete its liberation project. Activate and finish the resulting Frankel bounty.
Use the computer in @loc{The Lookout} in Brooklyn Heights and complete its liberation project. Activate and finish the resulting Tricky bounty.

achievements.description: Access a Safe House in Brooklyn.
achievements.summary: Enter a safe house in Brooklyn.

steps.text: In DUMBO, enter @loc{The Retreat}. Alternatively, enter @loc{The Lookout} in Brooklyn Heights.

achievements.description: Put out a call for backup in Brooklyn.
achievements.summary: Send a backup call from Brooklyn.

steps.text: While in Brooklyn, open the map and use @mechanic{Call for Backup}.

achievements.description: Respond to a call for help and revive a fellow agent in Brooklyn.
achievements.summary: Answer a Brooklyn backup call and revive an agent in Brooklyn.

steps.text: Have a friend call for backup from Brooklyn, then accept their call from the SHD tab.
Revive the friend after they are downed in Brooklyn.

achievements.description: Liberate all of Brooklyn's Main and Secondary locations.
achievements.summary: Liberate every main and secondary location in Brooklyn.

steps.text: Finish Brooklyn’s main and secondary locations through the @loc{Army Terminal} finale.
If the achievement stays locked after a co-op clear, replay Army Terminal solo and reach its final extraction.

achievements.description: Complete the intro mission in Upper West Side.
achievements.summary: Finish the Upper West Side introduction mission.

steps.text: Start Echoes of Central Park with your level-40 agent and complete its introduction mission in the Upper West Side.

achievements.description: Complete all the main missions in the Upper West Side.
achievements.summary: Complete the Upper West Side’s entire set of main missions.

steps.text: Complete the Upper West Side campaign, then check the map for main missions you have not finished. Clear any remaining main missions.

achievements.description: Complete all the side missions in the Upper West Side.
achievements.summary: Complete the Upper West Side’s entire set of side missions.

steps.text: Complete the side missions that appear as you advance through the Upper West Side campaign. Check the map for any side mission left unfinished.

achievements.description: Access a safehouse in the Upper West Side.
achievements.summary: Enter an Upper West Side safe house.

steps.text: Travel to a safe house icon on the Upper West Side map and enter the safe house.

achievements.description: Put out a call for backup in the Upper West Side.
achievements.summary: Send a backup call from the Upper West Side.

steps.text: In the Upper West Side, open the map and use @mechanic{Call for Backup}.

achievements.description: Equip and use your newly unlocked Howl skill.
achievements.summary: Equip and activate the Howl skill.

steps.text: Finish the @loc{Central Park} main mission, then equip the @mechanic{Howl} Pulse variant and activate the skill.

achievements.description: In the One Columbus Circle mission, defeat Cerberus and his Warhounds without using an armor kit.
achievements.summary: Finish One Columbus Circle by defeating Cerberus and his Warhounds without using an armor kit.

guide.context: If you use an armor kit, replay One Columbus Circle for another attempt.

steps.text: Play @loc{One Columbus Circle} without using armor kits. Defeat Cerberus and his Warhounds and finish the mission.

achievements.displayName: Done Within a New York Minute
achievements.description: In The Majestic mission, defuse the bombs within a minute.
achievements.summary: Defuse the bombs in The Majestic within one minute.

steps.text: On your first clear of @loc{The Majestic}, learn the bomb positions during the defusal objective.
On a replay of The Majestic, defuse the bombs within 60 seconds during the bomb objective. If you exceed the limit, replay the mission for another attempt.

achievements.description: Discover all Control Points in the Upper West Side.
achievements.summary: Discover the Upper West Side’s complete set of control points.

steps.text: Explore the Upper West Side and approach each control point until every control point is revealed on the map.

achievements.description: Unlock the last tier for one of your companions' signature abilities.
achievements.summary: Unlock the final tier of one companion’s signature ability.

steps.text: Choose one companion and check the signature ability upgrades in that companion’s interface.
Meet the requirements shown for the next available signature upgrade. Continue upgrading that companion’s signature ability until its final tier is unlocked.

achievements.description: Unlock all talents for one of your companions.
achievements.summary: Unlock every talent for a single companion.

steps.text: Select one companion and inspect that companion’s talent options.
Meet the displayed unlock requirements for that companion’s talents until none remain locked.
